meta.title: Urs dates of major Sufi shrines in Pakistan
how_to_read: last_observed = what news or official sources reported.
next_expected = my estimate from the rule; lunar dates can shift by 1-2 days with moon sighting.
confidence: high = rule and recent date both confirmed; medium = rule confirmed but next date estimated; low = no stable rule found; none = not researched.
upcoming_in_order: Golra Sharif - Pir Mehr Ali Shah (Islamabad)
meta.note: Urs dates are announced by Auqaf departments or district administrations; always confirm a few days before travelling.

shrines_with_researched_dates.name: Shrine of Shah Rukn-e-Alam
shrines_with_researched_dates.next_expected: About Oct 17-20, 2026 (UPCOMING). No official 2026 announcement found yet
shrines_with_researched_dates.notes: Date estimated from the lunar rule; confirm with Multan Auqaf/district administration.

shrines_with_researched_dates.name: Darbar Sultan Bahu
shrines_with_researched_dates.next_expected: About Nov 12 or Nov 19, 2026 (first Thursday of Jumada al-Thani 1448; depends on moon sighting)

shrines_with_researched_dates.name: Golra Sharif - Urs of Hazrat Babuji
Shrine of Lal Shahbaz Qalandar
shrines_with_researched_dates.urs_rule: 18-20 Shaban (official schedule can differ by a day or two)
shrines_with_researched_dates.last_observed: 774th Urs: Feb 9-11, 2026 (as announced by DC Jamshoro)

shrines_with_researched_dates.name: Shrine of Sachal Sarmast
shrines_with_researched_dates.last_observed: Urs held in Ramadan (earlier editions: 13-15 Ramadan)

shrines_with_researched_dates.name: Shrine of Madhu Lal Hussain (Mela Chiraghan)
shrines_with_researched_dates.urs_rule: No fixed lunar date found; set each year, usually March-April
shrines_with_researched_dates.last_observed: 438th Urs: Mar 28-30, 2026. Other years: 2022 Mar 26, 2023 Mar 11, 2024 Mar 2, 2025 Apr 12

shrines_with_researched_dates.name: Golra Sharif - Urs of Pir Abdul Haq Gilani (Lala Ji)
Shrine of Abdullah Shah Ghazi
shrines_with_researched_dates.last_observed: June 8, 2026 (22 Zil-Hajj 1447 AH; KMC local holiday)
shrines_with_researched_dates.notes: Some 2026 reports mistakenly print 1446 AH; 22 Zil-Hajj 1447 AH is the correct year for June 2026.

shrines_with_researched_dates.name: Shrine of Baba Farid Ganjshakar
shrines_with_researched_dates.urs_rule: Urs runs about 15 days, from 25 Zil-Hajj to 10 Muharram; Bahishti Darwaza opens around 5-6 Muharram
shrines_with_researched_dates.last_observed: 784th Urs, 2026 (Bahishti Darwaza opening ceremony reported June 19, 2026)
shrines_with_researched_dates.next_expected: Urs starts about May 31-Jun 2, 2027; Bahishti Darwaza about Jun 9-11, 2027
shrines_with_researched_dates.notes: Sources differ on whether the Bahishti Darwaza opens on the night of 5 or 6 Muharram.

shrines_with_researched_dates.name: Shrine of Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai
shrines_with_researched_dates.urs_rule: 14-16 Safar (3 days; Sindh public holiday on day 1)

shrines_with_researched_dates.name: Data Darbar
shrines_with_researched_dates.urs_rule: 18-20 Safar (3 days; local Lahore holiday on the main day)
shrines_with_researched_dates.last_observed: 983rd Urs: Aug 2-4, 2026 (Lahore local holiday on Aug 4)

shrines_with_researched_dates.name: Shrine of Bahauddin Zakariya
shrines_with_researched_dates.urs_rule: 3-day Urs; exact date set each year by the shrine and Auqaf
shrines_with_researched_dates.last_observed: Jul 20-22, 2026. An earlier edition was held Sep 23-25, 2021

shrines_with_researched_dates.name: Golra Sharif - Urs of Pir Mehr Ali Shah
Shrine of Bari Imam
shrines_with_researched_dates.urs_rule: Fixed Gregorian dates: Aug 15-17 (committee decision; chadar poshi on Aug 14)

shrines_with_researched_dates.name: Shrine of Bulleh Shah
shrines_with_researched_dates.urs_rule: 10 Bhadon (desi calendar), late August; local holiday on the middle day
shrines_with_researched_dates.notes: Corrects my earlier file, which listed this as an Islamic-calendar Urs.
